entries.title: The printed gift list ends with totals by type that match the Gifts tab
A gift list you can tick off by hand
entries.body: The printed gift list is now one compact table with a box for each thank-you written and mailed, amounts lined up, and page numbers. Choose the sort, whether to show addresses, group by type, or print only the thank-yous still to write.

entries.title: Tap the help button on any tab to open the Guide at that tab's section
Find any answer fast in the new Guide
entries.body: Search the whole Guide, browse by section, and follow short numbered steps. On a phone it opens full screen and the back button takes you up one level.

entries.title: The Getting ready card keeps what you are typing when the page updates
Mark a timeline entry family only, or set an arrive-by time, and guests never see either
Add a preferred name and greetings say Welcome back, Sam instead of using your account name
See your whole weekend on the Overview
entries.body: The Overview opens with your countdown, the Hebrew date, and every time and venue for the weekend. Copy the schedule to send to family.

entries.title: The greeting no longer says Welcome back, The
Needs you now names each invoice or task, and every Mark action has an 8-second Undo
Create your first event in one screen, and add your name afterwards
A Getting ready card walks you through setup and is saved for everyone on the event
Importing a guest list shows missing emails, missing addresses and possible duplicates before anything is saved
Choose whether guests can add people or change their reply on the RSVP page
Remind only the households still waiting
Review RSVP replies, accept or reject them, and undo an accept
Guests reply from a private link
Guest emails use your event's colors and logo
Mailing chips say which mailing they are
Message your guests from SimchaKit, or record what you sent by paper mail or on another platform
Switching tabs starts at the top
CSV exports open safely in Excel and Sheets
The main action for each tab sits in the top bar on desktop
In dark mode, your name at the bottom of the desktop sidebar (account row) showed as dark text on a dark background
The footer is now a single line with the SimchaKit credit, the about link, and the sync dot
Reset, expand/collapse, warning, and print controls now use icons instead of text symbols
Warning text in the guest, gift, favor, and vendor forms now uses the brand gold
The Print button inside the preview did nothing on iPhone
On iPhone the print preview could extend past the top of the screen, hiding its title and close button
Gift row actions are fully visible on touch devices instead of dimmed until hover
The type filter, search, and the Amount sort now look at every gift in a record, and the sort uses the record total
A giver with several gifts needs one thank-you note, so Written and Mailed stay tracked once per giver
Thank-you status is clearer, and the list can be sorted
The Guests tab banner now counts Maybe households as not yet responded, matching the mobile Pending chip
The Guests tab banner no longer reports that all RSVPs are received while guests still owe a sub-event answer
What Needs You Next flags guests who still need to answer when every household has replied
The loading screen shown while a switched event loads now uses that event's colors
Rows are real links, so Cmd-click or Ctrl-click opens an event in a new tab
Switch events from the sidebar without going back to the event picker
On a phone, a gift with a single giver shows one Thank-you label instead of repeating the giver's name
Attended is now shown as text (Attended, Did not attend, Unknown) instead of a color-only icon
A payment due today read as due tomorrow on the Overview
The Gifts tab's Thank Yous Pending card is now Thank Yous Outstanding
The Day-of Mode contacts list no longer cuts off long contact names on a phone
On mobile, a gift's giver names are no longer cut off with an ellipsis
On mobile, a small dot on the More button shows when a tab inside it, such as Gifts, has something outstanding
On the day of the event itself, the banner switches to It's today and cannot be dismissed
An info icon on the Vendors tab's Total Paid card explains why the remaining amount can show as negative
An info icon on Contract explains how it relates to Billed in Budget
Spacing between adjacent buttons was tightened where needed so the larger buttons do not sit too close together
Saving a gift now checks whether the save actually succeeded instead of always reporting success
Record more than one gift from the same giver in one gift record
The Print Brief's Kids box is now labeled Kids Attending and counts confirmed kids
The Kosher Meals card on the Guests tab counted every guest with the Kosher box checked, including guests who declined
